train_one_epoch: train a Mask R-CNN model for one epoch with gradient clipping and learning rate scheduling
evaluate_model: evaluate a detection model on a COCO dataset and compute bbox and segmentation IoU metrics
save_model_state: save a PyTorch model and optimizer checkpoint with the current epoch to a file path
load_model_state: load a PyTorch model and optimizer checkpoint from a file and optionally override hyperparameters
get_iou_types: determine which IoU types to evaluate based on whether the model is Mask R-CNN or Keypoint R-CNN
